summary_reason: Fatal tax domain error in Example 1 (associating 益金 with accounting expenses/費用), unnatural document terminology in Dialogue, imprecise collocation 4, and templated glossary contamination in both English and Vietnamese translations.

collocations.reason: Standard Japanese corporate tax terminology for including an item in taxable gross revenue (益金算入).
Standard Japanese corporate tax terminology for excluding an item from taxable gross revenue (益金不算入).
Acceptable in business tax discussion, referring to making tax adjustments regarding taxable revenue.
In Japanese tax accounting (Schedule 4 / 別表四), items are added to income (所得の金額に加算する) via taxable revenue inclusion (益金算入). Adding 'to 益金' is technically imprecise.

examples.reason: Factual mismatch in corporate tax: Accounting expenses (会計上の費用) are adjusted under deductible/non-deductible expenses (損金算入/損金不算入), not 益金. 益金 adjusts differences with accounting revenue (収益). Furthermore, the translations mechanically injected dictionary glosses.
examples.suggested_ja: 受取配当金について会計上の収益と税務上の取扱いの相違を調整するため、別表四において益金不算入の処理を行いました。
examples.suggested_vi: Để điều chỉnh sự khác biệt giữa doanh thu kế toán và quy định thuế đối với cổ tức nhận được, chúng tôi đã thực hiện bút toán loại trừ khỏi thu nhập chịu thuế trên Phụ lục 4.
examples.suggested_en: To reconcile the difference between book revenue and tax treatment regarding dividend income, we processed an exclusion from taxable revenue on Schedule 4.

dialogue.reason: '税理士の確認書' is an unnatural, contrived document name in Japanese corporate tax filing. In standard tax practice, companies prepare tax schedules (申告書添付書類/別表) and obtain tax agent documentation (税務代理権限証書 or 添付書面). The dialogue also lacks practical context.
